closedLimitation.observation: the preview digest covered execution events and identity but not the read watermark or known event count, so an observation-basis change could leave the digest unchanged

decision.reason: changing the existing previewDigest meaning would silently reinterpret every historical Preview; the ruling forbids that and asks for a clear distinction instead
decision.forwardCompatibleSurface: the attributed adapter returns a SEPARATE `provenance` block carrying the qualification state, source epoch id, durable binding reference, window-closed flag, read watermark, known event count and page coverage — so a consumer distinguishes semantic content from observation basis without changing the digest's meaning
decision.digestRemains: a deterministic digest of the SEMANTIC content, exactly as H1 defined it

whatAViewerCanDistinguish: what was actually read (watermark, known count, coverage)
